Manual follow-ups (4):
  1. app.config.ts:15 toc: The outline has a fixed title. Hide it on one page with toc: false in the frontmatter.
  2. content/2.guide/1.harbors.md The codemod dropped the links field, which @vite-hub/docs does not read. Put the links in the page body, for example as a ::card-group.
  3. content/index.md:10 ::u-page-hero is a Nuxt UI component, which the docs Markdown does not render. Rewrite the block with comark-ui blocks, such as ::card-group, or with the home layout.
  4. app/components/content/TideTable.vue Docus rendered this component from Markdown. Give @vite-hub/docs a component map with docs.components, so pages that use it keep rendering it.

Notes:
  - Page URLs stay the same: Nuxt Content dropped the order prefixes of file names, and @vite-hub/docs reads the order from navigation.order and .navigation.yml.
  - Without a content/docs/ folder, the docs are the whole site: content/index.md is /, and each folder in content/ is a section.
  - @vite-hub/docs renders GitHub callouts, ::note, ::tip, ::warning, ::caution, tabs, code groups, steps, and cards with comark-ui. See https://vitehub.dev/docs/docs-site.

Next steps:
  - Run `pnpm install` to install @vite-hub/docs and remove docus.
  - Run `npx nuxi dev` and open each section. A wrong frontmatter field stops the build with DOCS_CONTENT_INVALID.
